frame_metadata.gps_note: Every frame carries capture time with a -04:00 offset and the F0 build's 9-key GPS block. But from the first label (f0004, 16:18) to the exterior (f0028, 16:33) every frame carries the same fix, taken at 16:16:20 by the entrance: the phone produced no new fix indoors. The fix places the take at Cooper Hewitt; it says nothing about where in the building a frame was shot.

traps.date_shaped_accession: The number reads as a date, and the tester answered 'no number' on the spot. Cooper Hewitt's key is acquisition year, lot, item. See data/venues/cooper-hewitt.json traps. The note says it: the credit line reads 'Gift of' and the tester still saw no number, because the number looked like a date.
traps.no_designer_role_word: The maker line is just 'Marian Bantjes (Canadian, b. 1963)' — no 'Designed by'. The catalog records her as Designer.
